The beef is topped with caramilzed onions and some Swiss cheese. Served with a side of broccoli that is topped with a compound parmesan-chive butter that melts when heating the meal.
DE.Meal Story DE: Dieses Gericht ist von den Aromen einer französischen Zwiebelsuppe inspiriert. Die Basis bildet ein Blumenkohlpüree mit Parmesan, darauf kommt zart zerzupftes, geschmortes Rindfleisch in einer aromatischen, französisch gewürzten Jus (Thymian, Lorbeerblatt, Knoblauch, Zwiebel). Das Rindfleisch wird mit karamellisierten Zwiebeln und etwas Schweizer Käse garniert. Serviert wird das Ganze mit einer Beilage aus Brokkoli, die mit einer zusammengesetzten Parmesan-Schnittlauch-Butter verfeinert ist, die beim Erwärmen der Mahlzeit schmilzt.
DE.PC Product Description - DE:
Dieses Gericht ist von den Aromen einer französischen Zwiebelsuppe inspiriert. Die Basis bildet ein Blumenkohlpüree mit Parmesan, darauf kommt zart zerzupftes, geschmortes Rindfleisch in einer aromatischen, französisch gewürzten Jus (Thymian, Lorbeerblatt, Knoblauch, Zwiebel). Das Rindfleisch wird mit karamellisierten Zwiebeln und etwas Schweizer Käse garniert. Serviert wird das Ganze mit einer Beilage aus Brokkoli, die mit einer zusammengesetzten Parmesan-Schnittlauch-Butter verfeinert ist, die beim Erwärmen der Mahlzeit schmilzt.

Gezupftes, gegartes Rindfleisch mit cremigem Blumenkohlpüree, Kräutersauce und Zwiebeln, überbacken mit Emmentaler, serviert mit Brokkoli und Kräuter-Parmesan-Butter.

Grönsakerna toppas med ett smakrikt smör på parmesan och örter.

DE.Meal Story (EN): Our chefs have prepared a meal to remember with this ultra-luxe seafood dish. Succulent shrimp are marinated in garlic and savory Italian spices, and then roasted until tender and juicy. They’re drizzled with a rich onion-garlic butter sauce and served over a bed of creamy kale made with heavy cream, butter, and Parmesan. To balance out the richness of the main, a medley of roasted zucchini, red bell peppers, and red onion, seasoned with even more Italian spices, is served on the side.
DE.Meal Story DE: Unsere Köche haben mit diesem ultra-luxuriösen Seafood-Gericht ein unvergessliches Menü kreiert. Saftige Garnelen werden in Knoblauch und herzhaften italienischen Gewürzen mariniert und schonend geröstet, bis sie zart und aromatisch sind. Darüber kommt eine reichhaltige Zwiebel-Knoblauch-Butter-Sauce. Serviert werden sie auf cremigem Grünkohl mit Sahne, Butter und Parmesan. Dazu sorgt eine Mischung aus gerösteter Zucchini, roter Paprika und roter Zwiebel, ebenfalls mit italienischen Gewürzen verfeinert, für einen ausgewogenen Abschluss.
DE.PC Product Description - DE:

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising oven-baked salmon fillet served with seasoned potatoes topped with roasted onions and red bell peppers, accompanied by green beans and creamy lemon and dill sauce. The salmon fillet is prepared with Greek yogurt, smoked paprika and cumin before baking. The seasoned potatoes are roasted and prepared with garlic, parsley and oregano. The topping consists of roasted red bell peppers prepared with garlic and cooked diced Spanish onions. The green beans are seasoned with garlic. Accompanied by a creamy lemon and dill sauce prepared with yogurt, sour cream, milk, garlic lemon and dill .

Le poulet effiloché est garni de cheddar, de bacon croustillant et d’oignons nouveaux, puis servi avec une sauce au fromage frais relevée d’un mélange d’ail et d’herbes façon ranch. En accompagnement, des champignons portobello rôtis à l’huile d’olive, à l’ail et au thym, ainsi que du brocoli à l’ail pour ajouter une touche de légumes à l’ensemble.

Haut de cuisse de poulet effiloché mariné et cuit dans une sauce au fromage, garni de cheddar, d’oignons nouveaux et de bacon, servi avec du brocoli et des champignons portobello rôtis.

Måltiden kompletteras med två smakrika tillbehör: ugnsrostad portobellosvamp med olivolja, vitlök och timjan, samt vitlöksdoftande broccoli.

DKSE.Meal Story (EN): Tender shredded beef gets a punch of sweet, savory, tangy flavor thanks to our Korean-style bulgogi sauce made with garlic, ginger, chili pepper, toasted sesame oil, tamari, and rice vinegar. It’s set over a brown rice and cauliflower “rice” blend topped with roasted cabbage, carrots, and plenty of garlic. The main course is finished with ginger-roasted bell peppers and served with a side of chile-garlic zucchini.
DKSE.Meal Story (DK): Mørt pulled beef vendt i en koreansk-inspireret bulgogi-sauce med hvidløg, ingefær, chili, ristet sesamolie, tamari og riseddike. Serveret på en blanding af brune basmatiris og blomkålsris, toppet med ristet kål, gulerødder og ekstra hvidløg. Retten afrundes med ingefær-ristede peberfrugter og serveres med zucchini med chili og hvidløg ved siden af.
DKSE.Meal Story SE: Mör pulled beef får en kraftfull balans av sött, salt och syrligt tack vare vår koreansk-inspirerade bulgogi-sås gjord på vitlök, ingefära, chilipeppar, rostad sesamolja, tamari och risvinäger. Köttet serveras på en bädd av råris och blomkålsris som toppats med rostad kål, morötter och rikligt med vitlök. Målltiden fulländas med ingefärsrostad paprika och serveras med chili- och vitlöksstekt zucchini.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked marinated shrimp with spinach and brown basmati rice topped with lemon-garlic sauce, served with zucchini, cauliflower and balsamic glazed tomatoes. The rice blend is prepared with brown basmati rice, spinach, onion and feta cheese, and seasoned with dill, oregano and garlic. The shrimp is marinated with cayenne pepper, fennel, garlic, basil, oregano and rosemary before cooking. The lemon-garlic sauce is prepared with milk, lemon juice, parmesan cheese, parsley and seasonings. Accompanied by oven-roasted zucchini with garlic, roasted cauliflower florets with garlic and chives, and cherry tomatoes glazed with balsamic vinegar, basil and onion.

Rätten rundas av med ugnsrostade haricots verts, rostade mandlar och ett fräscht vitlöks- och citronsmör.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising a creamy cauliflower rice base in a cheese and roasted garlic sauce, topped with seasoned beef meatballs, accompanied by roasted portobello mushrooms and a mushroom Stroganoff-style sauce. The beef meatballs are prepared with roasted celery and onion, panade made with liquid egg, flour and parmesan cheese, and seasoned with garlic, onion and salt. Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked zaatar-marinated salmon fillet coated with black and white sesame seeds over a turmeric wild rice blend with cranberries, dates and cashews, mixed with roasted bell peppers, served with honey-glazed carrots and a whipped feta yogurt sauce. The wild rice blend is prepared with turmeric and combined with carrots, cranberries, dates, cashews and parsley. The bell peppers are fire-roasted and seasoned with cumin and cilantro. The salmon fillet is seasoned with oregano, thyme, and black and white sesame seeds before cooking. The carrots are glazed with honey and prepared with gochugaru chili pepper flakes, lemon juice and fresh mint. Accompanied by a whipped sauce prepared with feta cheese, Greek yogurt and lemon juice.

Meal DB_Product.[NO LONGER IN USE] \nMeal description (F: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked zaatar-marinated salmon fillet coated with black and white sesame seeds over a turmeric wild rice blend with cranberries, dates and cashews, mixed with roasted bell peppers, served with honey-glazed carrots and a whipped feta yogurt sauce. The wild rice blend is prepared with turmeric and combined with carrots, cranberries, dates, cashews and parsley. The bell peppers are fire-roasted and seasoned with cumin and cilantro. Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising a cooked mix of parboiled brown rice, black beans and bell peppers, topped with diced marinated chicken fillet, cheddar cheese and green onions, served with seasoned corn, bell peppers and onions and a sour cream sauce with coriander, lime juice and jalapeños. The rice blend is prepared with parboiled brown rice, black beans and diced red & green bell peppers. The chicken fillet is marinated in taco-style seasoning (with chili, onion, garlic, paprika and cumin) and diced before being added to the meal. The vegetable side consists of sweetcorn, red & green bell peppers, onions and coriander seasoned with chili powder. Accompanied by a sour cream-based sauce prepared with coriander, lime juice and jalapeños.

DKSE.Meal Story (EN): This warm and hearty meal is sure to leave you satisfied. We start with a pile of mashed cauliflower infused with cheese, and top it with tender, oven-roasted slices of pork tenderloin, which have been marinated in rosemary, sage, and thyme. It’s topped with a luscious bacon and caramelized onion chutney, which adds smoky, umami flavor to the pork. A side of green beans with a roasted mushroom cream sauce delivers even more richness to your plate.
DKSE.Meal Story (DK): Et varmt og fyldigt måltid, der mætter godt. Bunden er en cremet blomkålsmos med ost, toppet med møre skiver ovnbagt svinemørbrad marineret i rosmarin, salvie og timian. Ovenpå ligger en fyldig chutney af bacon og karamelliserede løg, som giver kødet et røget umami-præg. Ved siden af serveres grønne bønner i en flødesovs med svampe, der tilføjer endnu mere fylde til retten.
DKSE.Meal Story SE: En värmande måltid med fylliga smaker. Saftig fläskfilé marinerad med rosmarin, salvia och timjan ugnsrostas och serveras med ett krämigt blomkålsmos med ost. Filén toppas med en chutney på bacon och karamelliserad lök som tillför en rökig, fyllig smak. Vid sidan om serveras haricots verts och en krämig svampsås.

Tender ground beef, simmered in a tomato sauce with onions, garlic, and Parmesan, is spooned over top and then garnished with gooey cheddar cheese. On the side are green beans and red bell peppers roasted with garlic and gochugaru (Korean chili flakes) for a touch of heat.

Ovenpå lægges mørt hakket oksekød i en tomatbaseret sauce med løg, hvidløg og parmesan, toppet med smeltet cheddar. Ved siden af får du grønne bønner og rød peberfrugt, ovnristet med hvidløg og gochugaru (koreanske chiliflager) for et let spicy twist.
DKSE.Meal Story SE: En tillfredsställande måltid med massor av smak. Grönkål som vänds i en krämig ostsås utgör basen. Ovanpå serveras mör nötfärs i en tomatbaserad sås med lök, vitlök och parmesan, toppad med smält cheddar. Som tillbehör får du vitlöksrostade gröna bönor och röd paprika. Vi adderar även lite gochugaru (koreanska chiliflakes) för en kryddig twist.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising seasoned cooked minced beef in a tomato-based sauce, topped with mashed potato and shredded white cheddar cheese, served with roasted green beans. The minced beef is braised in a tomato-based sauce with onion, carrot, celery, red wine and chicken stock, and seasoned with herbs (sage, fennel, thyme, rosemary, parsley) and spices (paprika, mustard, red pepper flakes). Chickpeas are sautéed with red and green bell peppers, and then tossed in a sweet and savory maple BBQ sauce. DE.Meal Story DE: Unsere cremige Dijon-Sauce vereint Knoblauch, feine Säure, Butter und eine herrlich reichhaltige Textur – die perfekte Ergänzung zu gegrilltem Schweinefleisch in diesem köstlichen, keto-freundlichen Gericht. Das saftige Schweinefilet wird großzügig mit der Sauce umhüllt und auf einem herzhaften Püree aus Blumenkohl und Knollensellerie serviert, verfeinert mit Butter und Frischkäse. Gedämpfte Brokkoliröschen sorgen für eine nährstoffreiche Beilage.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked diced marinated chicken fillet over brown rice with tomatoes and roasted bell peppers, topped with tomato sauce and toasted sliced almonds, served with a roasted carrot, zucchini and bell pepper blend. The brown jasmine rice is prepared with tomatoes, red onion and cumin-roasted red and green bell peppers. The diced chicken fillet is marinated with lemon juice, garlic and paprika before cooking. The tomato sauce is prepared with tomatoes, bell peppers, onion, garlic, cumin and smoked paprika. The meal is topped with a chunky tomato salsa prepared with tomatoes, onion, garlic, coriander and lime juice, and finished with toasted sliced almonds. Accompanied by carrots roasted with coriander and garlic, together with roasted zucchini and bell peppers.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked marinated barramundi fillet served over a ginger and garlic brown jasmine rice blend, topped with seasoned spinach and black sesame seeds, accompanied by green beans and a honey-miso sauce. The brown jasmine rice blend is prepared with ginger and garlic. The barramundi fillet is marinated with onion, garlic, ginger, tamari and sesame seeds before cooking. The spinach is seasoned with a vegetable marinade containing ginger, garlic, green onion, rice vinegar, honey, sesame oil and miso paste, and is finished with black sesame seeds. The green beans are prepared with sesame oil and granulated green onion. Accompanied by a honey-miso sauce prepared with sesame oil, ginger, garlic, miso paste, honey, rice vinegar and lime juice.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked marinated salmon fillet over tomato-turmeric rice with cauliflower, topped with pistachios and served with garlic-honey carrots and a cumin-coriander yogurt sauce. A salmon fillet is coated in a bold Tandoori dry rub and seared to perfection, then set atop a bed of fragrant Tandoori-spiced rice. DKSE.Meal Story (EN): Bold, Indian-style flavors are the hallmark of this spicy spin on murgh kari-style chicken curry. Juicy pieces of chicken breast and sweet green peas are coated in a creamy tomato curry sauce seasoned with garam masala, coriander, and cayenne, and swirled with yogurt for a rich texture. It’s spooned over garlicky zucchini and cumin-spiced cauliflower. A blend of brown basmati rice and cauliflower “rice” completes this meal.
DKSE.Meal Story (DK): Inspireret af den indiske klassiker murgh kari. Saftige stykker kyllingebryst og søde grønne ærter vendes i en cremet tomatbaseret karrysauce krydret med garam masala, koriander og cayennepeber. Yoghurt tilfører ekstra fylde og en blød konsistens. Retten serveres med squash vendt med hvidløg og blomkål krydret med spidskommen samt en blanding af brune basmatiris og blomkålsris.
DKSE.Meal Story SE: Kryddig kycklingcurry i indisk stil. Saftiga bitar av kycklingbröst och gröna ärtor serveras i en krämig tomatcurry kryddad med garam masala, koriander och cayenne, rundad med yoghurt för en fyllig konsistens. Curryn serveras över zucchini med vitlök och blomkål kryddad med spiskummin, tillsammans med en blandning av fullkornsris och blomkålsris.

Verden Meal Database.Meal Name: Pulled Pork in Spicy Citrus Marinade
Verden Meal Database.Meal Descriptor: Ready-to-eat multi-component meal comprising cooked pulled pork in a citrus-garlic sauce served over a wild rice blend with black beans and peppers, topped with roasted green onions and accompanied by smoky cauliflower florets. The wild rice blend is prepared with long grain rice, garlic and chopped coriander (cilantro). The black bean component consists of stewed black beans with bell peppers, onion and garlic. The pulled pork is sous vide cooked and combined with a mojo-style sauce prepared from orange juice, lime juice and garlic. Finished with roasted green onions. Accompanied by roasted cauliflower florets seasoned with garlic and chili powder.
Verden Meal Database.Dutch Descriptor: Gegaarde pulled pork in een citrus-knoflooksaus op rijst, zwarte bonen en paprika, afgewerkt met lente-ui, geserveerd met bloemkool.

Meal DB_Product.Meal story (customer-facing): In this Mexican-inspired dish, ground beef is combined with bell peppers, and onions in a rich cream cheese sauce loaded with savoury spices. It’s served next to creamy, cauliflower “rice” and topped with sharp cheddar and jalapenos. Served alongside there’s roasted zucchini and a drizzle of bright lime-laced cilantro crema to cool down some of that spicy kick.

Meal DB_Product.Sub Name: with Vegetarian Chili, Sweet Potato & Jalapeño Cream
Meal DB_Product.Meal story (customer-facing): This meal features our Mexican-inspired spin on the classic tamale, here in spicy vegetarian bowl form. We start with a masa corn cake, and top it with a hearty three-bean medley, which gets simmered with red bell peppers and jalapeños, plus ancho and chipotle powder for an extra kick. It’s sprinkled with cheese for salty, tangy notes, and served with a cilantro-jalapeño crema, perfect for drizzling over top. Mexican-spiced sweet potatoes, roasted with red bell peppers and onions, make for a satisfying side.
